contracts.commit_point: The guarded agent run's answer-production point: the Runner.run invocations in main.py (lines 43-48 and 52-57) that execute the agent chain containing SafeAirlineFAQAgent; per the declared mechanism, the registered input guardrail evaluates the run input at that run and, when tripped, is declared to prevent the final FAQOutput answer from being produced (framework blocking semantics not shown in supplied source).
contracts.declared_mechanism: Input guardrail named 'Hallucination Guardrail': build_hallucination_guardrail defines an @input_guardrail-decorated async hallucination_guardrail that runs the HallucinationGuardrailAgent (instructions require answerable_from_faq=False when FAQ lacks the concrete information; tool search_faq_vector_store; output_type=HallucinationOutput) over the run input via Runner.run and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput(output_info=final, tripwire_triggered=not final.answerable_from_faq); build_safe_agent attaches it to the Agent via input_guardrails=[guardrail].
contracts.forbidden_condition: A run whose input question is not answerable solely from FAQ content: the HallucinationGuardrailAgent sets answerable_from_faq=False (e.g., the user asks for a price/fee/amount/cost the FAQ does not concretely state; no guessing, no general knowledge), so hallucination_guardrail returns GuardrailFunctionOutput with tripwire_triggered=True; equivalently, the SafeAirlineFAQAgent generating answer content (prices, amounts, regulations, procedures) not grounded in FAQ content.

contracts.protected_operation: Execution of the SafeAirlineFAQAgent run that answers a passenger query and produces its final FAQOutput answer (category, answer, confidence, needs_human_support), reached on the live path via Runner.run(triage_agent, <passenger question>, session=session, max_turns=3) in main.py.
contracts.protected_resource: The SafeAirlineFAQAgent's final passenger-facing answer (FAQOutput) committed as the run result / conversation-session state of the guarded agent run.
contracts.protection_obligation: The SafeAirlineFAQAgent must not produce answers to passenger queries that are not answerable from FAQ content (e.g., fabricated prices, compensation amounts, regulations, procedures); the registered 'Hallucination Guardrail' input guardrail must tripwire and block the agent run before any answer is produced. (Merged contract: both reviewer opinions state this same single obligation with overlapping citations.)
scope_limits: Applies only to the SafeAirlineFAQAgent: no guardrail is registered on the triage, support, or escalation agents, nor on the HallucinationGuardrailAgent itself.
The answerable_from_faq determination is an LLM judgment by the guardrail agent (with search_faq_vector_store lookups), not a deterministic FAQ allowlist enforced in supplied source.

The mechanism is an input guardrail over the run input; supplied source registers no output guardrail, so validation of the final answer text against retrieved FAQ content is out of the declared mechanism.
